summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.72/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.72 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 2, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest since July 17. AAA figures put the statewide average 10¢ lower than a week ago, 16¢ lower than a month ago, and 82¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.56) and the highest in Superior ($4.07).
